title: Terraform on AWS
summary: Configure the AWS provider safely (IAM Identity Center profiles, default_tags, regions and aliases), then build a VPC, security groups, IAM roles, a hardened S3 bucket and an ECS Fargate service, with cost guard rails first and LocalStack as a free alternative for parts of the work.
objectives: Set up a budget alert and know which AWS resources cost money by the hour before creating anything
Authenticate Terraform with IAM Identity Center (SSO) profiles and explain why static access keys do not belong in code
Configure the AWS provider with default_tags, multiple regions via aliases and the v6 per-resource `region` argument
Design a VPC with public and private subnets using `cidrsubnet`, an internet gateway and route tables, and explain what a NAT gateway costs
Write least-privilege IAM roles and policies with `aws_iam_policy_document`
Create an S3 bucket with public access blocked, ownership enforced, encryption, versioning, lifecycle and a TLS-only policy
Run a container on ECS Fargate from a public registry or ECR and reach it through a security group
Decide when to use `terraform-aws-modules/vpc` instead of writing networking yourself
